structured_output.notes:
23 distinct searches and 18 fetch attempts (12 succeeded; Deccan Herald returned 403 and one Native Planet page 410). Search-snippet-only findings were not turned into claims because I had no verbatim page text. Leads to verify on primary or established-newspaper pages:
- Deccan Herald reported the BDA issued a letter of acceptance to Shankara Narayana Constructions for BBC Package 1 (Rs 3,348 crore, about 21 km). No date seen.
- Deccan Herald reported the cabinet approved revised compensation for 948 acres of PRR/BBC land.
- Deccan Herald, 'Adani's bid is 96% above benchmark', conflicts with the News Minute's roughly 24%/28% per-package figure. The base for the percentage is unclear.
- The Supreme Court directed GBA corporation polls by 30 June 2026. Another source says the polls are scheduled for December 2026. Unresolved.
- Bengaluru–Chennai Expressway: the Karnataka section opening is dated December 2024 by DH/NoBroker (per search summaries) but December 2025 by Swarajya. Conflict unresolved.
- B-khata to A-khata: the cabinet extended the scheme to all urban local bodies. The 2% fee window, 16 May to about 23 Aug 2026, is from Landeed and Brigade blogs and may have lapsed.
- Metro Pink Line first section (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere) was reported ready around Sept 2026, awaiting CMRS safety approval.
- RMP-2041: BDA global tender floated Aug 2025; no draft found. RMP 2015 remains in force.
- Cauvery Stage V (775 MLD, Rs 4,336 crore, inaugurated 16 Oct 2024) is the latest found. Eight villages were reported still unserved, with no 2026 update.
- K-RERA: enforcement reports come only from PropNewz, a blog. These include a Mantri penalty of up to 5% and FY24-25 audit defaults enforced from 1 Apr 2026.
- KWIN City: a KIADB PMC tender for Phase 4-5 closed 4 Jul 2026. No land acquisition notice was found. SWIFT City (about 1,000 acres near Sarjapur) has no status newer than early 2025.
- Double-decker: Metro Phase 3 double-decker viaducts (Rs 9,700 crore, 37.121 km) were approved by the cabinet in 2025. Silk Board double-decker openings were reported in 2026 only by aggregators.
- No official BMRCL, karnataka.gov.in, ANAROCK, Knight Frank or JLL page was retrieved. The site: operators returned no results from those domains.
- I did not run a separate search on the Revised Master Plan for GBA-related planning powers, the Suburban Rail project, or Hosur/Sarjapur airport links.
